name: Inner Mongolia Yitai Coal Co.,Ltd.
summary: Inner Mongolia Yitai Coal Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production, transportation, and sale of coal in the People's Republic of China. It operates in four segments: Coal, Coal Chemical, Transportation, and Oil & Gas. The company is involved in the production and sale of coal, coal chemical, and oil and gas products. It also provides railway and road transportation services.
